fields.Name: W2 -> S5.2
fields.Description: Gate G2.4 (phase 2, dataset W2, criterion S5.2): over W2-noise s100-s159, the mean of (winner's reported holdout AUC - fresh AUC) is below +0.0104 (T13; +0.0416 today, 19 of 20 above fresh). A statistical gate: the pytest node tests/gates/test_seeds400.py::test_W2_S5_2_winner_optimism runs one search per seed and asserts that all 60 ran; PS_SEED_LIMIT lowers the count for a reduced run, which skips that assertion. It runs once on the final head. The node is Python, so the mutation is a substitute: it fails when the sidecar chooses its finalist by holdout AUC instead of the inner-CV rule (mean optimism >= +0.0104 over the 60 seeds; at 20 seeds the substitute stays below the bound).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Mean winner optimism over W2-noise s100-s159 (60 seeds, asserted) is below +0.0104 (1 of 1 pytest case).
